heroSummary: Saint Paul Public Schools grades 1-12 begin Tuesday, September 7, 2027. Pre-K and kindergarten have Welcome Meetings September 7-8 and begin Thursday, September 9; ECSE follows the Pre-K calendar. MEA is October 21-22, Winter Break is December 23-31, Spring Break is April 3-7, and the last day is June 9, 2028.
calendarNotes: Grades 1-12 begin September 7. Pre-K, kindergarten, and ECSE follow the Welcome Meeting schedule and begin September 9. October 29 and March 31 are PreK–5 no-school dates; grades 6–12 remain in session, including grades 6–8 at PreK–8 schools. The PDF lists October 11 simply as No School for PreK–12 and does not state a reason.

customSections.label: Start Dates by Grade
customSections.content: SPPS begins the year in two stages. Grades 1–12 start September 7; Pre-K and kindergarten use September 7–8 for Welcome Meetings and begin classes September 9. ECSE follows the Pre-K schedule.

customSections.label: October 29 and March 31 Are No-School Days for PreK–5 Only
customSections.content: SPPS marks these two dates green rather than blue. PreK–5 students do not attend. Grades 6–12 remain in session, including grades 6–8 at PreK–8 schools.

rows: In session; Quarter 3 still ends that day

customSections.label: How to Read the SPPS Calendar Colors
customSections.content: Check the color before treating an SPPS date as a districtwide closure. Green dates apply only to PreK–5; grades 6–12 are still in school.

customSections.label: What Changed From 2026–27
customSections.content: Both school-year calendars are published by SPPS. These are the main date changes for families.

customSections.label: October 11 Is Listed Simply as “No School”
customSections.content: The English PDF says only No School for PreK–12 on October 11. Because the source does not name a holiday, conference, or staff purpose, this page preserves the official wording rather than supplying a reason.

customSections.label: Grading Periods
customSections.content: SPPS uses four quarters. Quarter start dates below are based on the next scheduled student day after the preceding quarter ends; the SPPS PDF explicitly lists the quarter-end dates. Quarter 3 ends March 31, a PreK–5 no-school date when grades 6–12 are still in session.

customSections.label: What This Calendar Does Not Cover
customSections.content: The printable district calendar covers the main attendance schedule. Families in specialized settings should confirm program instructions, and all families should use the district or school calendar for bell times, activities, detailed conferences, and schedule changes.

whatsNew.title: What's Different From 2026-27
content: The grades 1-12 first day moves from September 8 to September 7; the Pre-K and kindergarten first day moves from September 10 to September 9.
An all-grade no-school date appears on October 11 without a printed reason.
MEA shifts from October 15-16 to October 21-22.
Winter Break begins December 23 in both years but ends December 31 instead of January 1.
Spring Break moves from April 5-9 to April 3-7.
The future year adds two all-grade staff development closures in April and May.
The last day moves from June 11 to June 9.

calendarFaqs.q: When does SPPS start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1-12 start Tuesday, September 7, 2027. Pre-K and kindergarten hold Welcome Meetings September 7-8 and start Thursday, September 9. ECSE follows the Pre-K calendar.
The official 2027-28 PDF labels October 11 only as No School for PreK-12 and does not print a reason. This page preserves that official wording rather than inferring one.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SPPS MEA break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: SPPS students in all grades have no school October 21-22, 2027, for the state teacher meeting commonly called MEA.

calendarFaqs.q: Do SPPS secondary students have March 31, 2028 off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. March 31 is a PreK-5 conference closure and the end of Quarter 3, but grades 6-12 remain in session.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SPPS Winter Break in 2027-28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Thursday, December 23, through Friday, December 31, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SPPS Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 3, through Friday, April 7, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of SPPS in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for PreK-12 and the end of Quarter 4 are Friday, June 9, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the SPPS 2027-28 calendar available in other languages?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. SPPS publishes official Hmong, Karen, Somali, and Spanish editions in addition to English.

sourceReviewDetails: The grade-specific opening schedule, districtwide no-school dates, PreK–5-only closures, quarter endings, breaks, holidays, and last day were checked against the official English PDF.
The PDF color key was reviewed because green dates apply only to PreK–5 while grades 6–12 remain in session.
October 11 is listed simply as No School for PreK–12; no reason was inferred because the PDF does not provide one.
Quarter start dates are based on the next scheduled student day after each printed quarter-end date.
Official Hmong, Karen, Somali, and Spanish PDFs are linked separately as translations of the district calendar.
The MySchoolDates .ics file is a one-time import and does not sync with later SPPS revisions.
